app.title: Branchly
app.tagline: Manage your Git projects without the command line.
sidebar.pull_all_hint: Fetches every project and fast-forwards the ones that can be. Nothing is merged and nothing is overwritten.
sidebar.empty_hint: Add a folder that already contains a Git project, or clone one from a server.
sidebar.summary_incoming_one: 1 project with news from the server
sidebar.summary_incoming_many: {count} projects with news from the server
category.delete_prompt: Delete the category “{name}”? The projects in it stay, they just move to “Without category”.
repo.rename_prompt: Display name in Branchly (the folder is not renamed):
repo.remove_prompt: Remove “{name}” from the list? Nothing is deleted on disk — the folder and all its history stay exactly where they are.
repo.missing_hint: “{path}” does not exist any more, or is no longer a Git project.
repo.add_not_git: This folder is not a Git project
repo.add_not_git_hint: “{path}” contains no Git data. Pick the top folder of a project, or clone a project from a server instead.
repo.add_duplicate: This project is already in your list.
status.detached_hint: You are looking at a single saved version, not at a branch. New commits would not belong to any branch. Create a branch first if you want to change something here.
changes.title: Changes
changes.none_hint: As soon as you edit a file in this project, it shows up here.
changes.commit_needs_summary: Please write a short summary first
changes.amend: Add to the previous commit instead
changes.discard_prompt: Throw away your changes in “{name}”? This cannot be undone — the file goes back to the last saved version.
changes.stage_hint: Tick the files you want to save together.
diff.title: Comparison
diff.target_worktree_index: Your edits vs. what is ready to commit
diff.target_index_head: Ready to commit vs. last saved version
diff.target_worktree_head: Your edits vs. last saved version
diff.no_selection: Pick a file to see what changed.
diff.binary: This is not a text file
diff.binary_hint: Branchly cannot show the differences line by line. Open the file to look at it.
diff.too_large_hint: Showing the first {count} lines. Open the file to see all of it.
history.empty_hint: Once you save your first change, it appears here.
graph.title: Graph
graph.reset_soft: Move branch here, keep all my work
graph.reset_mixed: Move branch here, keep my files
graph.reset_hard: Move branch here and throw my work away
graph.legend: Each line is a branch. Dots are saved versions, newest at the top.
branch.delete_prompt: Delete the branch “{name}”? Commits that only exist on this branch would be lost.
branch.invalid_name_hint: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and slashes. No spaces, no “..”, and it cannot start with a dash.
branch.uncommitted_hint: Save or discard them first, then switch branch.
sync.no_remote_hint: It only exists on this computer. That is fine — you just cannot send or fetch anything.
sync.push_rejected_hint: Someone else sent changes in the meantime. Get their changes first, then send yours.
sync.auth_failed: The server did not accept your login
sync.auth_failed_hint: Branchly does not store Git logins — Git handles them. Check your saved credentials or your SSH key.
clone.title: Clone a project
clone.invalid_url_hint: Use an https:// address or an SSH address like git@server:user/project.git.
clone.url_suspicious_hint: It contains characters or options that could make Git do something you did not ask for. Branchly refuses to use it.
clone.target_missing: Pick a folder to save into.
clone.nonempty_hint: “{path}” already contains {count} item(s). Cloning into it keeps everything that is already there and adds the project files next to it. If a file has the same name as one from the project, Git stops and nothing is changed.
clone.nonempty_is_repo: This folder is already a Git project
clone.nonempty_is_repo_hint: “{path}” contains Git data of its own. Cloning into it would create a project inside a project. Pick an empty folder, or add the existing project instead.
conflict.title: Bring the changes together
conflict.intro_title: Two versions of the same lines
conflict.intro_hint: You and someone else changed the same places. Branchly walks you through them one by one — for each one you just say which text should end up in the file.
conflict.reason_both_changed: You both changed the same line.
conflict.reason_both_added: You both added something in the same place.
conflict.reason_deleted_by_them: You changed it, the other side deleted it.
conflict.reason_deleted_by_us: You deleted it, the other side changed it.
conflict.apply_to_all: Do this for all remaining ones
conflict.finish_hint: {count} file(s) are ready. Saving them finishes bringing the two versions together.
conflict.abort_hint: Everything goes back to how it was before. Your own saved work is not touched, but the decisions you just made are lost.
conflict.custom_hint: Whatever you type here ends up in the file, exactly like this.
conflict.binary_title: This file cannot be merged line by line
conflict.binary_hint: Pick which whole file you want to keep.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language_restart_hint: Branchly switches to the new language the next time you start it.
settings.confirm_destructive: Ask before anything is thrown away
settings.confirm_destructive_hint: Strongly recommended. Turning this off means actions that lose work happen right away.
settings.auto_check_hint: Branchly looks at your projects in the background and shows what is new. It never changes anything on its own.
settings.check_online_hint: Off means only your local folders are looked at — no network is used.
settings.check_updates: Look for Branchly updates on startup
settings.check_updates_hint: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer Branchly exists. Nothing is downloaded or installed until you say so.
settings.github_token_hint: Needed for pull requests, issues and build status. It is stored in your system keychain, never in a file.
settings.github_token_invalid: GitHub did not accept this token.
settings.github_token_no_keyring_hint: Branchly will not store the token in a plain file. Install a keychain service, or leave the GitHub features off.
settings.repair_deps_hint: Opens the installer to reinstall the pinned packages into .venv. Close Branchly before repairing PySide6.
settings.repair_deps_confirm: Branchly will open the installer in a separate window. Close this app before the installer replaces packages that are currently in use.
github.not_github: This project is not on GitHub
github.not_github_hint: Pull requests, issues and build status only work for GitHub projects. Everything else in Branchly works as usual.
github.no_token_hint: Add an access token in the settings to see pull requests, issues and build status.
github.rate_limited: GitHub is asking us to slow down
github.rate_limited_hint: Too many requests. Branchly will try again in {count} minute(s).
confirm.title: Are you sure?
confirm.reset_hard_hint: Everything you changed since “{version}” is deleted for good, including files you have not saved yet. There is no undo.
confirm.checkout_detached_title: Just looking at an old version
confirm.checkout_detached_hint: You can look around, but changes you save here would not belong to any branch and are easy to lose. Better: start a new branch from this version.
confirm.force_push_hint: Commits on the server that you do not have would be deleted. If someone else pushed in the meantime, their work is gone.
confirm.revert_hint: Branchly adds a new commit that takes back what “{version}” did. The old commit stays in the history.
error.title: That did not work
error.git_missing_hint: Branchly uses Git itself to do the work. Install Git, then start Branchly again.
error.timeout: Git took too long and was stopped.
error.not_a_repo: This folder is not a Git project.
error.locked: Another Git program is working in this project right now. Try again in a moment.
error.unsafe_argument_hint: “{value}” could make Git do something that was not asked for.
installer.title: {app} setup
installer.heading: Install {app}
installer.subtitle: Creates a local environment and installs the exact package versions for {version}. You can run this again anytime to repair or update.
installer.option_system: Also install Qt system libraries (may ask for your password)
installer.option_recreate: Delete .venv and create it from scratch
installer.summary_no_venv: No virtual environment yet — install to create one.
installer.summary_repair: {count} package(s) missing or at the wrong version — repair to fix.
installer.summary_ok: Every pinned package is present at the correct version.
installer.summary_done: Installation finished. You can start Branchly now.
installer.system_prompt:
Qt needs a few system libraries. Run this command now?

{command}
installer.failed: Installation did not finish cleanly. Check the log for details.
installer.close_busy: Installation is still running. Quit anyway?
pull_all.title: Update all projects
pull_all.heading: Bring every project up to the server's version
pull_all.explain_one: One project will be fetched and fast-forwarded if that is possible. It is left alone if it has your own changes or your own commits — nothing is merged, nothing is overwritten.
pull_all.explain_many: {count} projects will be fetched and fast-forwarded where that is possible. Projects with your own changes or your own commits are left alone and named below — nothing is merged, nothing is overwritten.
pull_all.nothing: There is no project to update.
pull_all.busy: A check is still running. Try again in a moment.
pull_all.skip_dirty: your own changes are not saved yet
pull_all.skip_no_upstream: the branch does not follow a server branch
pull_all.skip_own_commits: your own commits are not sent yet
update.title: Updates
update.available_hint: Branchly can fetch it and restart itself; your projects, settings and token stay as they are.
update.unknown_local: Branchly cannot tell which version is installed
update.unknown_local_hint: This installation is not a Git checkout, so there is nothing to compare. The newest version is {remote}.
update.confirm: Branchly fetches the new version, closes and starts again. Your projects, settings and token are untouched. Anything you have not saved in another program is unaffected.
update.not_github: No GitHub project is configured for updates.
update.check_failed: Branchly could not find out whether there is a newer version.
update.blocked_dirty: Branchly's own folder has uncommitted changes
update.blocked_dirty_hint: Commit or discard them first. An update must never throw away work you did on Branchly itself.
update.pull_failed: The new version could not be fetched
update.download_failed: The new version could not be downloaded
update.write_failed: The new files could not be written
about.description: A calm Git client: your projects in categories, a clear picture of what changed, and merges you can understand.
github.title: GitHub
github.scope_hint: The token may be missing a permission for this action. Settings, GitHub tab shows which permissions it carries.
github.read_only_hint: This account may only read this repository.
github.conflict: Someone changed this in the meantime
github.not_mergeable: This cannot be merged right now
github.asset_too_large: The file is too large to upload
error.file_unreadable: The file could not be read
github.name_invalid: A name may only hold letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.
github.pr_same_branch: Source and target branch are the same.
github.mergeable_unknown: GitHub is still working that out
github.merge_method_merge: Merge commit: keeps every commit and adds one that joins them
github.merge_method_rebase: Rebase: the commits are replayed onto the target branch
github.merge_title_placeholder: Leave empty for GitHub's own title
github.merge_no_method: This repository allows no merge method.
github.merge_draft_hint: A draft cannot be merged. Mark it as ready first.
github.review_body_required: A text is needed for everything but an approval.
github.review_own_hint: GitHub does not allow approving your own pull request.
github.release_draft: Keep as a draft, publish nothing yet
github.release_generate_notes: Let GitHub write the list of changes
github.release_name_placeholder: Leave empty to use the tag name
github.release_delete_question: The release for {tag} will be removed. The tag itself stays.
github.asset_delete_question: {name} will be removed from this release permanently.
github.settings_read_only: This account may not change these settings.
github.feature_archived: Archived, nothing can be changed any more
github.repo_auto_init: Create a README, so the repository can be cloned straight away
github.repo_create_failed: The repository could not be created
github.repo_delete_detail: Issues, pull requests, releases, wiki and every setting go with it. This cannot be undone.
github.repo_deleted_hint: The local copy is still here. Nothing was changed locally.
github.repo_forget_question: Should {name} be removed from the project list as well? The folder stays on disk.
github.merge_method_off: This repository switched that method off.
github.comment_delete_question: The comment will be removed permanently.
github.label_delete_question: {name} is removed from the repository and from every issue carrying it.
github.milestone_delete_question: The issues in it keep existing and simply lose the milestone.
github.tag_delete_question: {tag} disappears from the server. Anyone who already fetched it keeps it.
github.delete_branch_on_merge: Delete the branch automatically after a merge
github.collaborator_changed: Done. An invitation only takes effect once it is accepted.
clone.repo_list_failed: The repository list could not be loaded
github.label_rename_hint: Renames the selected label to the name typed above.
github.label_rename_needs_name: Type the new name in the field above first.
github.milestone_close_hint: Closes the milestone without deleting it, so the history keeps it.
ignore.tracked_hint: This file is already tracked. An entry in .gitignore changes nothing until it is removed from version control.
ignore.pattern_empty: There is nothing to ignore here
